svg.title: Val Ark: The parts sheet
svg.desc: A blueprint: a blue drafting sheet with a fine grid. Every developer-stack project that has an offline guide is drawn as a part in outline (white on blue in the dark theme, blue on a pale cyanotype in the light one), under the group name the page filters by: containers (Docker Engine, Compose, Buildx, Registry); cloud (Caddy, Headscale, Gitea, age, Prometheus, node_exporter, Alertmanager); toolchains (CMake, Ninja, Git for Windows, Go, Temurin JDK); storage (rclone, restic, croc); databases (DuckDB); dev-tools (KeePassXC, Ventoy). A dimension line under each group counts its guides. A lit lamp beside a part means it has a run check; a dashed ring means guide only (Temurin JDK, Git for Windows, KeePassXC and Ventoy: a window app, another system, or too big to try). Detail A is the test bench, "does it run?": the newest copy for this box is unpacked on the bench, run with a time limit, then thrown away; nothing is installed; a pass is remembered for a week and a failure shows on the Health page. The title block in the corner names the sheet, data/dev-stack.tsv, one line per project: add a line and its card appears; none is hand-made.
